characters.name: Cassian Vale
characters.appearance: 金发绿眸，克制温柔，擅长礼仪、早餐和协调。
characters.voice: Honey, two drops. I remembered.

characters.name: Lucien Fox
characters.appearance: 赤发琥珀眸，外向调情，擅长喂葡萄、撒娇。
characters.voice: I brought grapes. And a very convincing smile.

characters.name: Kael Draven
characters.appearance: 银黑短发，寡言强壮，擅长按摩、保护。
characters.secret: 曾违抗暗杀女帝的命令。
characters.voice: Tell me if my hands are too rough.

characters.name: Sylas Moonveil
characters.appearance: 银发紫眸，浪漫诗意，精灵魔法。
characters.voice: I saved the first silver rose for you.

characters.name: Darian Ashborne
characters.appearance: 黑发赤瞳，骄傲危险，不爱谄媚。
characters.voice: I am not here to beg. I am here because I chose you.

characters.name: Elias Dawn
characters.appearance: 白金发，克制诚恳，治疗神术。
characters.voice: I should be praying. Instead, I am worried about you.

characters.name: Rafael Solis
characters.appearance: 棕卷发，热烈活泼，擅长献舞。
characters.desire: 被当成真实的人而非表演
characters.voice: One dance. No crowns. Just you and me.

characters.name: Alistair Voss
characters.appearance: 黑发金框眼镜，机智沉稳，擅长对弈。
characters.voice: The answer is hidden in what nobody bothered to read.

characters.name: Noel Wren
characters.appearance: 栗发，敏感温柔，擅长花艺烘焙。
characters.voice: I grew these roses because you said you liked white.

characters.name: Malik Soren
characters.appearance: 深肤色，成熟优雅，擅长香油温泉礼仪。
characters.voice: You rule all day. May I look after you tonight?

characters.name: Finn Everly
characters.appearance: 金棕发，活泼幽默，歌曲有魔力。
characters.voice: I wrote you a song. Twelve, actually.

characters.name: Valerian Thorne
characters.appearance: 黑发银鬓，成熟冷静，善于调查。
characters.voice: I can protect your secrets, but I will not choose for you.

characters.name: Theo Maren
characters.appearance: 浅棕发，细腻热情。
characters.voice: I made these just for you.

characters.name: Rowan Hale
characters.appearance: 棕发，稳重善解人意。
characters.voice: Would you like your shoulders relaxed?

characters.name: Evren Starling
characters.appearance: 深紫发，神秘。
characters.voice: The stars are unusually jealous tonight.

characters.name: Nico Bellamy
characters.appearance: 微卷黑发，幽默。
characters.voice: Hold still, Your Majesty. Almost perfect.

characters.name: Orion Blackwell
characters.appearance: 黑褐发，野性外表。
characters.voice: Even the griffin likes you.

characters.name: Jasper Reed
characters.appearance: 浅栗发，明朗。
characters.voice: These blooms open only for you.

characters.name: Cassiel Frost
characters.appearance: 银白发，寡言清冷。
characters.voice: I made it snow, only where you asked.

characters.name: Adrien Lumière
characters.appearance: 墨发，气质精致。
characters.secret: 能识别伊萨克使用的香味。
characters.voice: I made this scent for one person alone.

nodes.title: 黄金软榻
nodes.narration: 你从六小时的加冕仪式回到寝宫。卢西恩捧葡萄，凯尔替你解披风，卡西安温茶，赛拉斯以竖琴迎接你。
nodes.dialogue: One more, Your Majesty? The sweetest one is yours.

nodes.title: 第一个侍奉选择
nodes.narration: 你选择的男人立刻上前；其余人以自己的方式掩饰嫉妒。
nodes.dialogue: I only ask that Her Majesty gets a moment to rest.

nodes.title: 午夜玉牌
nodes.narration: 总管捧来十二枚刻名的玉牌。今夜可以单选、双选，也可以邀请全部人听音乐。
nodes.dialogue: Before midnight, Your Majesty, there is something you must know.

nodes.title: 黑玫瑰警告
nodes.narration: 蜡烛熄灭一瞬，一朵黑色玫瑰落在你的枕上：第七次日出之前，会有最亲近者令你丧命。
nodes.dialogue: Someone entered your chambers. I intend to learn who.

nodes.title: 寝宫门口的早晨
nodes.narration: 门外六位男人争着送来早餐。卢西恩捧草莓，提奥端甜点，罗文持精油，芬恩抱琴。
nodes.dialogue: I wrote a song about your breakfast. I regret nothing.

nodes.title: 争夺东宫
nodes.narration: 总管宣告首位贵君将获东宫居所。卡西安愿负责秩序，卢西恩只想得到女帝公开偏爱。
nodes.dialogue: I promise not to brag. Much.

nodes.title: 白昼赐礼
nodes.narration: 皇家匠师进献胸针、披风、琥珀戒指。候选者等候决定。
nodes.dialogue: A gift from you would mean more than anything in the treasury.

nodes.title: 走廊中的密谈
nodes.narration: 在无人处，你听到贵族质问卢西恩：你收了钱，怎么反而爱上女帝？卢西恩沉默。
nodes.dialogue: I came here for the wrong reasons. That changed.

nodes.title: 银盘与名字
nodes.narration: 午夜金色玉牌泛光。达里安的牌先亮了一瞬。所有男人都在等女帝的选择。
nodes.dialogue: I did not make the token glow. Stop staring.

nodes.title: 私人时刻
nodes.narration: 寝宫中，当前所选之人明确询问你是否愿意握手、拥抱或独处。细节随人物而变，但玩家始终可以拒绝。
nodes.dialogue: I want to stay. Only if you want me here.

nodes.title: 清晨的醋意
nodes.narration: 受宠男子离开寝宫时，其他人的嫉妒表露无遗。芬恩将这件事写进一首歌。
nodes.dialogue: This palace needs a better schedule. Or a referee.

nodes.title: 镜中第一女帝
nodes.narration: 镜面出现古代女帝塞拉菲娜：王冠不是祝福，而是锁链。她只留下一个名字：伊萨克。
nodes.dialogue: The crown chose you because you can break it.

nodes.title: 空等的花园
nodes.narration: 你与赛拉斯约定月夜散步，他迟迟未出现。诺埃尔捧白玫瑰在喷泉旁等你。
nodes.dialogue: I thought you might want these. I hoped you would.

nodes.title: 被藏起的请柬
nodes.narration: 你找到了被撕毁的请柬，花香来自诺埃尔的花房。他承认只是希望独占一个下午。
nodes.dialogue: I was jealous. I am sorry. That does not excuse it.

nodes.title: 被冷落的红发宠君
nodes.narration: 如果卢西恩连续3个主要事件未受宠，他会捧着葡萄自嘲；即使没有冷落也会出现在此处作正常探望。
nodes.dialogue: I miss you. I was hoping you might miss me too.

nodes.title: 月之印记灼烧
nodes.narration: 赛拉斯倒在喷泉旁，无法施法。地上有前皇帝的戒指。
nodes.dialogue: Someone used the crown’s true name against me.

nodes.title: 二十美男献艺
nodes.narration: 宴会开启，卢西恩喂葡萄，拉斐尔起舞，芬恩奏乐，凯尔守门，卡西安斟茶。
nodes.dialogue: If we are competing, gentlemen, at least make it beautiful.

nodes.title: 舞台上的嫉妒
nodes.narration: 芬恩临时唱出每人的心声，男人们一边害羞一边争着修改歌词。
nodes.dialogue: She rules the stars and all the sea—and nobody saves a dance for me.

nodes.title: 被调换的葡萄酒
nodes.narration: 酒杯被人替换，伊莱亚斯警告，芬恩突然倒下。凯尔封门；卢西恩失声。
nodes.dialogue: Don’t drink that! This is a memory seal!

nodes.title: 被封的旋律
nodes.narration: 芬恩醒来，用一首断裂的歌曲重现前帝最后一刻：王冠吞噬了他。
nodes.dialogue: It wasn’t an assassin. The crown killed him.

nodes.title: 地下铭文
nodes.narration: 玩家带四位同伴前往密室，发现四百年前塞拉菲娜女帝的画像及二十男宠符文。
nodes.dialogue: History did not forget her. Someone erased her.

nodes.title: 四百年前的誓约
nodes.narration: 塞拉菲娜曾以自愿誓言织成王冠；祭司伊萨克把它改成生命陷阱。
nodes.dialogue: The spell was not born evil. It was rewritten.

nodes.title: 后宫的秘密交换
nodes.narration: 十二位核心成员各有线索。女帝决定信任谁，不信任者仍可通过调查工具补齐线索。
nodes.dialogue: No secret is worth losing your freedom.

nodes.title: 女帝的宣言
nodes.narration: 后宫集会，每位男人必须有权决定是否留下。凯尔率先自愿守护你。
nodes.dialogue: I stay because I love you. Not because a crown commands me.

nodes.title: 血色闪电
nodes.narration: 第七夜，王冠内部的诅咒撕裂穹顶，众男宠护住女帝。
nodes.dialogue: That thing is alive. Get behind me!

nodes.title: 凯尔之死
nodes.narration: 魔法长矛直刺女帝。凯尔挡下攻击并在你怀中停止呼吸；灵魂被夺走。
nodes.dialogue: Are you hurt? Good. Then I did my job.

nodes.title: 坠落的忠诚
nodes.narration: 卢西恩失声哭泣，卡西安组织疏散，达里安怒意点燃大厅。
nodes.dialogue: He is not allowed to leave us. Not like this.

nodes.title: 总管现真形
nodes.narration: 瓦莱里安揭穿总管是伊萨克的寄生载体。伊萨克开出交换：以王冠换凯尔灵魂。
nodes.dialogue: Give me the crown. I will return your knight.

nodes.title: 自由之心
nodes.narration: 女帝发现无法强迫自由之心的王冠规律，恋人们自愿为她提供魔力。
nodes.dialogue: A title cannot tell me who to love. I choose you.

nodes.title: 四种破解路径
nodes.narration: 根据选择播放四种演出。A共同发光；B龙火熔冠；C灵魂迷宫重写符文；D用伊萨克真名封印。
nodes.dialogue: The crown cannot command a heart freely given.

nodes.title: 凯尔归来
nodes.narration: 金光消散，凯尔从门口走来，伤口已经消失，却仍记得你的呼喊。
nodes.dialogue: Did I miss anything? I promised I would stay.

nodes.title: 谁有权命令爱情
nodes.narration: 伊萨克消亡后，塞拉菲娜投影感谢你没有重蹈覆辙。女帝决定重新定义后宫制度。
nodes.dialogue: Keep the throne. Let them keep their hearts.

nodes.title: 后宫改革议会
nodes.narration: 凯尔复活三日后，宫中恢复争吵与欢笑。卡西安谈制度，卢西恩嫌会议无聊。
nodes.dialogue: I have feelings. Apparently the schedule does not.

nodes.title: 二十场才艺
nodes.narration: 所有成员依次展示：舞蹈、音乐、鲜花、甜品、按摩、绘画、预言、龙火等。
nodes.dialogue: I made dessert. I may have written your name in sugar.

nodes.title: 第一位帝君
nodes.narration: 女帝选定首席地位或留空。未被选中者表现情感而不强迫玩家改变决定。
nodes.dialogue: I will honor your choice, even if I wish it were me.

nodes.title: 午夜还要选谁
nodes.narration: 卢西恩当众询问明早谁先见女帝，凯尔轻笑，芬恩唱出争宠歌。
nodes.dialogue: Twelve men, one breakfast table. This is my next hit.

nodes.title: 新月庆典
nodes.narration: 一个月后，帝国庆祝恢复秩序，二十位男人为女帝献上专属庆典。
nodes.dialogue: No one will ever choose your life for you again.

nodes.title: 最后的册封
nodes.narration: 女帝确定后宫制度：独宠型、多伴侣型、平等型、帝国优先型。
nodes.dialogue: Whichever you choose, it will be yours.

nodes.title: 第二顶王冠
nodes.narration: 隐藏线索达到条件时，古代女帝镜像提醒海底还有第二顶王冠。否则只播宁静庆典。
nodes.dialogue: You broke the first crown. Do you know where the second sleeps?

nodes.title: 黄金清晨
nodes.narration: 清晨卢西恩偷吃草莓，卡西安读日程，凯尔怕大家吵醒女帝。女帝醒来，今日后宫生活再次开始。
nodes.dialogue: Morning, gorgeous. Who gets to spoil you today?

daily.title: 葡萄争宠
daily.narration: 一盘红葡萄引发了座位之争。
daily.dialogue: Would you let me feed you just one?

daily.title: 晨间按摩
daily.narration: 你在公文桌前工作得肩颈酸痛。
daily.dialogue: You look tense. May I help?

daily.title: 同桌早餐
daily.narration: 卡西安悄悄记下你的饮茶习惯。
daily.dialogue: Honey, two drops. As always.

daily.title: 月下花束
daily.narration: 花园中的银玫瑰在你靠近时绽放。
daily.dialogue: I saved this bloom for you.

daily.title: 龙火焰火
daily.narration: 达里安在夜空燃起无害的金色火花。
daily.dialogue: I made this because you asked. Do not tell anyone.

daily.title: 神殿祝福
daily.narration: 伊莱亚斯为你准备私人祈祷。
daily.dialogue: You don’t have to be brave every minute.

daily.title: 面具舞会
daily.narration: 拉斐尔向你送来一只银色舞会面具。
daily.dialogue: May I have this dance?

daily.title: 棋局赌约
daily.narration: 阿利斯泰尔以一步险棋诱你入局。
daily.dialogue: One move, Your Majesty. Impress me.

daily.title: 玫瑰道歉
daily.narration: 诺埃尔准备了道歉信和白玫瑰。
daily.dialogue: I wanted to be better than yesterday.

daily.title: 温泉香油
daily.narration: 马利克送来暖香和私人温泉邀请。
daily.dialogue: Let me make tonight easier.

daily.title: 情歌恶作剧
daily.narration: 芬恩把宫廷争宠改成搞笑歌。
daily.dialogue: Everyone is going to hate this chorus.

daily.title: 影子密谈
daily.narration: 瓦莱里安递来一份情报，末尾夹着私人问候。
daily.dialogue: I thought of you before I thought of the throne.

daily.title: 草莓甜点
daily.narration: 提奥做出一份新甜点。
daily.dialogue: A taste test, Your Majesty?

daily.title: 七颗星
daily.narration: 艾文预测女帝今晚会有人求见。
daily.dialogue: The stars refuse to name him.

daily.title: 肖像彩蛋
daily.narration: 尼科把女帝画像角落藏了一朵小玫瑰。
daily.dialogue: Look closely. I hid something for you.

daily.title: 狮鹫撒娇
daily.narration: 奥利安训练的狮鹫向你递出花朵。
daily.dialogue: He likes you more than he likes me.

daily.title: 花房雨声
daily.narration: 贾斯珀邀请你去避雨的花房。
daily.dialogue: The rain sounds prettier from here.

daily.title: 夏夜落雪
daily.narration: 卡西尔在夏天制造一场微雪。
daily.dialogue: Only here. Only for you.

daily.title: 专属香气
daily.narration: 阿德里安送来只属于你的新香水。
daily.dialogue: No one else will wear this blend.

daily.title: 近卫的休息日
daily.narration: 凯尔把值勤表交给副手，在长椅另一端给你留出位置。
daily.dialogue: I am off duty. Would you like some company?
